solver: LISFLOOD-FP 8.3 GPU ACC, FP64 with local shared-face conservation correction
boundary: FREE -1 on four external edges, same as original baseline
rain_application: uniform across all cells, including roofs and lakes; roofs represented by DSM heights
limitations: Original 49.95 mm synthetic experiment, not an observed storm reconstruction.
Accepted full-fill terrain and trial lake bathymetry retain the previously documented assumptions.
Roof cell water is not ground flooding; report ground flooding separately from roofs and initial lakes.
The original run used a dry 4 m bare-earth grid; this 1 m run changes resolution, terrain and initial water together.
Native GPU .mass does not fully account dynamic rain and open-boundary fluxes; check water volumes independently.
rain_integration: Audited from exact per-step start time, original NetCDF values and previous cuda::dt; first rain increment is zero in upstream ACC order.
